Title: Regarding Problems of tabacco farmers in Andhra Pradesh. 

SHRI MAGUNTA SREENIVASULU REDDY (ONGOLE): Sir, I would like to bring to the attention of the Government the problems of tobacco farmers in Andhra Pradesh. There is severe damage to the FCV crop. The Mandous cyclone devastated the districts of Prakasam and Nellore of Andhra Pradesh. You might be aware of the same. Cyclone of this magnitude has arrived for the first time in 50 years. This happened three weeks ago. Farmers have incurred heavy losses. In the plantation of the tobacco crop, 53,000 hectares have been laid, out of which 25,000 hectares have been damaged.I would request the hon. Commerce Minister to appoint a team to undertake a survey of the losses the FCV crops have incurred. I am also requesting for rescheduling of crop loans with 100 per cent interest subvention for five years, and to ensure prompt payment of incentives and sanction of fresh loans by banks as it is a severe natural calamity.

I request the hon. Commerce Minister to sanction interest-free loan of Rs. 50,000 per barn by the Tobacco Board, payment of compensation of Rs. 20,000 per acre to Tobacco farmers, and also inclusion of FCV Tobacco crop in the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bhima Yojna.

Title: Regarding Flood and Erosion in Malda and Marshidabad Districts in West Bengal. 

13.00hrs.

SHRI ABU HASEM KHAN CHOWDHURY (MALDAHA DAKSHIN): Sir, I wish to draw your kind attention towards the issues of utmost importance related to my Parliamentary constituency of Malda and Murshidabad. The issue relates to the problem of flood and erosion caused by Ganga river that has been causing huge damages in Malda and Murishabad. It has wreaked havoc for the last many years on both sides of the Ganga river in my constituency. The river has changed its course and has moved 35 kilometres towards the town of Malda resulting in lakhs of people losing their homes, fertile land, and their livelihood. The areas affected by erosion and flooding are very densely populated. In Murshidabad district, Samsherganj, Dhuliyan, Hussainpur, Diyara, Neemtita, and in Malda district, Bhutni, Manichak, Birnagar and Gopalpur, all these areas have been completely wiped out. All the massive buildings have submerged into the river. People of these areas are homeless and have no food and money.

HON. CHAIRPERSON: Please conclude. I think it is the last sentence.

SHRI ABU HASEM KHAN CHOWDHURY: The nature of erosion is that if you go the next day after the erosion, you will see nothing. The UPA Government considered it a natural disaster and the UPA Government did the best along with the State Government. The Present Central Government only takes care of 10 kms from the Farakka Barrage. The State Government is supposed to look after beyond 10 kms. The history of the State Government is that it has no funds and no capacity to encounter the disaster. The Central Government and the State Government will have to come forward jointly in a big way to deal with this disaster.

Title: Regarding increasing the monthly pension of EPF pension for better Medical Facilities for them. 

SHRI V.K. SREEKANDAN (PALAKKAD): Respected Sir, it has been a demand of the Employees Provident Fund pensioners numbering over 65 lakhs to increase the minimum monthly pension from the present amount of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 9,000 including Dearness Allowance.

डॉ. निशिकांत दुबे (गोड्डा): माननीय सभापति महोदय, मैं आपके माध्यम से पूरे देश का ध्यान झारखण्ड में हो रहे अवैध खनन और उसमें मुख्यमंत्री, झारखण्ड की अवैध रूप से संलिप्तता के बारे में ध्यान आकृष्ट करना चाहता हूँ । 

महोदय, मैं संथाल परगना के इलाके से आता हूँ, वहाँ माइनिंग के सिवाय रोज़गार का कोई दूसरा साधन नहीं है । आपको आश्चर्य होगा कि हमारे यहाँ 19 लाख करोड़ साल पुराना फॉसिल है, जो विश्व की धरोहर है ।

उसके ऊपर बीरबल साहनी ने पूरा रिसर्च किया और उत्तर प्रदेश में बीरबल साहनी पुराविज्ञान संस्थान, लखनऊ में है । उस सारे फॉसिल की भी स्टोन माफिया ने पूरी तरह क्रशिंग कर दी है । मुख्य मंत्री जी के सचिव जेल के अंदर हैं, मुख्य मंत्री के बिजनेस पार्टनर जेल के अंदर हैं, जो माइनिंग सेक्रेट्री थे, वे भी जेल के अंदर हैं । उनके सीए के यहां 20 करोड़ रुपए पकड़े गए हैं । ईडी ने जब अपनी जांच आगे बढ़ाई, तो उस जांच में यह पता चला कि यह पूरा स्कैम 10 हजार करोड़ रुपए का है । 

यह स्कैम कितना बड़ा है, आप इससे अंदाजा लगा सकते हैं कि जो ट्रक्स साहिबगंज और मनिहारी जो घाट हैं, सभापति महोदय, आप चूंकि बिहार को बहुत अच्छे तरीके से जानते हैं, वहां दस ट्रक्स डूब गए । दस ट्रक्स डूब गए और आज तक, छ: महीने हो गए, उन ट्रकों का मालिक कौन है? उन ट्रकों को लेने के लिए कोई नहीं आया । ट्रक में जो ड्राइवर बैठा हुआ था, उसकी डेथ हो गई, उसके लिए कोई नहीं आया, जिस खलासी की डेथ हो गई, उसके लिए कोई नहीं आया । 

मेरा यह मानना है कि एनजीटी के रूल्स का वॉयलेशन हो रहा है, माइनिंग एक्ट के रूल्स का वॉयलेशन हो रहा है, गिट्टी और बालू का अवध पैमाने पर केवल खनन ही नहीं हो रहा है, ये बांग्लादेश तक जा रहे हैं । बांग्लादेश के साथ हमारा बॉर्डर लगा हुआ है । सारे माफिया बांग्लादेश और आईएसआई कंट्रोल्ड हैं । ये सारे पैसे प्रिवेंशन ऑफ मनी लाँड्रिंग एक्ट में बाहर चले गए हैं । 

सभापति महोदय, मेरा आपके माध्यम से आग्रह है कि सारे रूल्स भारत सरकार के हैं । माइनिंग एक्ट भारत सरकार का है और एनजीटी एक्ट भारत सरकार का है । वहां का आम आदमी परेशान है । मुख्य मंत्री खुद इसमें इनवॉल्वड हैं । मुख्य मंत्री के सचिव के यहां जब रेड होती है, तो उनके ब्लैंक चेकबुक्स नजर आते हैं । 

अत: इसकी सीबीआई इंक्वायरी हो, इसकी एनआईए की इंक्वायरी हो क्योंकि यह बांग्लादेश जा रहा है । हमको इससे मुक्त कीजिए और देश के दस हजार करोड़ रुपए, जो बाहर चले गए हैं, उनको वापस लाकर गरीबों में बांट दीजिए ।

Title: Need to abolish the requirement of Income criteria in Scholarship Schemes for Scheduled Tribes students- Laid. 

DR. HEENA VIJAYKUMAR GAVIT (NANDURBAR): Several provisions have been incorporated in the Constitution for safeguarding and promoting the interests and rights of the Scheduled Tribes in various spheres so as to enable them to join the national mainstream. Article 46, Article 275, Articles 335 and Articles 342 cast a duty on the State to promote with special care, the educational and economic interests of the Scheduled Tribes. The Government of India is taking several steps to promote the welfare of Students belonging to scheduled, tribe community through scholarship. However, the actual objective of these schemes to uplift the marginalized is defeated due to the presence of an income criteria of the family. In Pre Matric and Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST students the family income limit is 2,50,000 per annum and for National Overseas Scholarship for ST students for studying abroad and National Scholarship Scheme, it is 6 lakh per annum. The mandatory requirement of a family income is against the constitutional guarantees provided to Scheduled Tribes and it is a form of exclusionary practise which denies benefits to the deserving candidates who have been deprived for several years. I request the Government to kindly abolish the requirement of income criteria in scholarship schemes for Scheduled Tribe students in order to provide them a level playing field.

Title :Regarding construction of Multipurpose Dam and Hydroelectric Power project on River Banshadhara in Koraput district, Odisha- Laid. 

SHRI SAPTAGIRI SANKAR ULAKA (KORAPUT): Banshadhara river happens to be the biggest river of undivided Koraput District. The river originates in the border of Thu Rampur in Kalahandi and Kalyansinghpur in Rayagada district of Odisha and runs for about 254 kilometers. The total catchment area of the river basin is about 10,830 square kilometers. Though the river originates in Odisha and passes about 170 KM in Odisha not a single drop is being utilized in the State, where as Andhra Pradesh constructed multiple dams on the downstream course of the river. 

There lies a risk of submergence to all the river bay habitats including sub division town Gunupur in case of flood and depletion of ground water level too. Gunupur and surrounding blocks are drought prone areas and agricultural activities are rain dependent. The river being lifeline of my Constituency, I would like to request the Government to construct a multi-purpose dam for irrigation and hydro-electric power project on upstream, in line with Polavaram or Indira Sagar Project on river Godavari. 

We demand a centrally sponsored National project to facilitate irrigation and help improve economic conditions of largely downtrodden people of the region. I would urge upon the Government to initiate all that is required to build a dam and hydroelectric power project on Banshadhara river in Odisha.

Title : Regarding access of advanced Medical Technology for patients suffering from Heart valve disease- Laid.  

DR. LORHO PFOZE (OUTER MANIPUR): A large population in India suffers from valvular heart disease. While degenerative heart valve diseases mainly affect older people, developing Countries witness the prevalence of rheumatic heart valve disease, affecting the younger population. 

Medical technologies to deliver better/safer patient outcomes are some developments over the past six decades. Pioneering work in heart valve replacement started in the early 1950s. Mechanical valves were introduced to replace the natural valves in the human heart and treat valvular heart disease. However, one of the inherent limitations of this technology included requiring patients to be on life-long blood thinners. 

A better solution was proposed in the 1970s with the development of biological tissue valves using either porcine (pig) or bovine (ox) pericardium, allowing patients to lead a better quality of life. However, tissue valves presented degeneration limitation and required repeat surgery. The newer tissue valves exhibit evidence of upto 30 years of longevity among patients over 60 years.

The most recent revolution is the advent of transcatheter valve replacement as an alternative to surgical intervention in severe aortic stenosis patients. Transcatheter aortic valve implantation does not require open-heart surgery.

I urge upon the Government to create an enabling environment to access advanced medical technology for all patients.

Title: Regarding fee structure of Allahabad University 

श्रीमती संगीता आजाद (लालगंज): सभापति महोदय, मैं आपका ध्यान उत्तर प्रदेश का ‘ऑक्सफोर्ड’ कहे जाने वाले इलाहाबाद विश्वविद्यालय की तरफ ले जाना चाहती हूं, जहां पिछले लगभग 100 दिनों से छात्र आंदोलन कर रहे हैं । वहां पर एक ऐसे कुल सचिव की नियुक्ति कर दी गई है, जो तानाशाह है और जिसने स्टूडेंट्स से मिलना तक जरूरी नहीं समझा । वहां बच्चे संघर्ष कर रहे हैं, आंदोलन कर रहे हैं । वे उनसे मिल कर अपनी समस्या बताना चाह रहे हैं, लेकिन कुलसचिव जी के पास इतना समय नहीं है कि वे उनसे मिल सकें ।

सर, मैं चाहती हूं कि आपसे एक निर्देश प्राप्त हो, जिससे वहां की स्टूडेंट्स की फीस की वृद्धि में कमी की जाए और उसी अनुपात में एस.सी./एस.टी., ओबीसी और ईडब्ल्यूएस की छात्रवृत्ति में बढ़ोतरी की जाए और ज़ीरो बैलेंस पर एडमिशन किया जाए । 

सर, इसी तरह के आंदोलन उत्तर प्रदेश के कई विश्वविद्यालयों में, जैसे बी.एच.यू., पूर्वांचल और आज़मगढ़ के महाराजा सुहेलदेव विश्वविद्यालय में भी जारी हैं । केन्द्र और राज्य, दोनों में आपकी सरकार चल रही है । मेरा माननीय मंत्री जी से अनुरोध है कि इसमें हस्तक्षेप करें और गरीब, शोषित, वंचित छात्रों की मांगों को पूरा करें । महोदय, मैं एक और समस्या की ओर आपका ध्यान आकर्षित करना चाहूंगी ।… (व्यवधान) आज़मगढ़ के महाराजा सुहेलदेव विश्वविद्यालय में अभी बी.एड. की काउंसलिंग कराई गई, जिसमें लिखित परीक्षा और प्रैक्टिकल में कम नम्बर्स दिए गए । अन्य विश्वविद्यालयों की तुलना में वहां के छात्रों को काफी कम अंक प्राप्त हुए हैं, जिससे छात्रों ने महाराजा सुहेलदेव विश्वविद्यालय से संबंधित महाविद्यालयों में एडमिशन नहीं लिए हैं । इसके कारण हजारों सीट्स खाली रह गई हैं ।… (व्यवधान)
